cases.mid: 画面表示・レイアウト (Screen display / layout)
cases.name: Initial maintenance screen renders with header, key fields and the entry prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator has just started the Transaction Category Maintenance transaction (ORTC); no data has been entered yet.
cases.steps:
1. Sign on and select Transaction Category Maintenance (transaction ORTC) from the main menu.
2. Observe the screen as first displayed.
cases.expected: The maintenance screen (map MTCATA) opens with the header line showing Tran `ORTC`, Pgm `OCTCAT`, the system title `ORION CREDIT CARD MANAGEMENT SYSTEM` and the current date and time; the captions `Type Code:`, `Cat Code :` and `Desc     :` are shown with empty input fields; the bottom legend reads `ENTER=Process  PF3=Back  PF4=Clear`; the message line shows `Enter type + category code and press ENTER.`
cases.remark: UI §2.1 MTCATA / mapset MTCAT · 0000-MAIN (EIBCALEN=0) → 1000-SEND-INITIAL · 8000-POPULATE-HEADER · WS-M-PROMPT · legend literal L24 of MTCAT.bms

cases.mid: 初期値・デフォルト (Initial values / defaults)
cases.name: On open the input fields are empty, the cursor rests on Type Code and the state is key-entry
cases.precondition: F-STD. The transaction (ORTC) has just been started (first entry, no commarea).
cases.steps:
1. Start transaction ORTC.
2. Observe the initial values and cursor position.
cases.expected: The Type Code, Cat Code and Desc fields are all blank; the cursor rests on the Type Code field; the message line shows `Enter type + category code and press ENTER.`; the screen is at the key-entry state so a save is not yet possible.
cases.remark: 1000-SEND-INITIAL: MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MTCATAO · MOVE -1 TO TCTYPEL (cursor) · WS-M-PROMPT · CA-WORK-AREA(1:1)='K' (WS-ST-KEY)

cases.mid: 文字・書式表示 (Characters / format display)
cases.name: Category code is redisplayed zero-padded to four digits and the header shows the ISO date and time
cases.precondition: F-STD. Category Type `01` / code `0002` exists on file (RESTAURANT).
cases.steps:
1. On the maintenance screen enter Type Code `01` and Cat Code `2`.
2. Press ENTER to look up the category.
3. Observe the Cat Code field and the header date/time.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=2 (on file as 0002, RESTAURANT)
cases.expected: The Cat Code field is redisplayed right-justified and zero-padded as `0002`; the header shows the current date in ISO form (`2026-09-28`) and the time as `HH:MM:SS` (e.g. `09:15:42`); the message line shows `Category found. Change text, PF5 to update.`
cases.remark: 2100-LOOKUP: MOVE WS-TC-CD TO WS-CD-ED (PIC 9(04)) → TCCDO · 8500-GET-DATE-TIME FORMATTIME DATESEP('-') YYYYMMDD/TIME · WS-M-FOUND

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: PF4 clears the entered values and returns to the initial prompt
cases.precondition: F-STD. The operator has typed Type Code `01`, Cat Code `0001` and some description text but has not saved.
cases.steps:
1. Type Type Code `01`, Cat Code `0001`, Desc `TEST TEXT`.
2. Press PF4.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001, Desc=TEST TEXT
cases.expected: The screen is redisplayed cleared: Type Code, Cat Code and Desc are blank; the message line shows `Enter type + category code and press ENTER.`; the state returns to key-entry so any prior lookup is discarded.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF4 → 1000-SEND-INITIAL (MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MTCATAO, state 'K', WS-M-PROMPT)

cases.mid: 状態遷移 (Screen / state transitions)
cases.name: Two-step maintenance: key-entry to record-loaded to saved across pseudo-conversational turns
cases.precondition: F-STD. Category Type `01` / code `0001` exists on file (RETAIL PURCHASE).
cases.steps:
1. On the key-entry screen enter Type Code `01`, Cat Code `0001` and press ENTER (first turn).
2. The record is loaded; change Desc to `RETAIL PURCHASES` and press PF5 (second turn).
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001, new Desc=RETAIL PURCHASES
cases.expected: After ENTER the state moves from key-entry to record-loaded (existing) and the message line shows `Category found. Change text, PF5 to update.`; after PF5 the change is saved and the message line shows `Transaction category updated.`; the key and state are carried between turns by the pseudo-conversational commarea, so the second turn knows the record was already looked up.
cases.remark: state CA-WORK-AREA(1:1): 'K'→'E' (2100-LOOKUP REC-FOUND) → save (2300-SAVE, state 'E' → 3500-UPDATE-TCAT) · 9000-RETURN TRANSID(ORTC) COMMAREA(ORION-COMMAREA)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Look up an existing transaction category and open it for maintenance
cases.precondition: F-STD. Category Type `01` / code `0001` exists on file with description `RETAIL PURCHASE`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`, Cat Code `0001`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001
cases.expected: The category is found; its description `RETAIL PURCHASE` is shown in the Desc field; the message line shows `Category found. Change text, PF5 to update.`; the cursor moves to the Desc field so the operator can change it and save with PF5.
cases.remark: 2100-LOOKUP → 3000-READ-TCAT RESP(NORMAL) REC-FOUND · MOVE TC-DESC TO TCDESCO · state 'E' · MOVE -1 TO TCDESCL · WS-M-FOUND · TCATFILE (transaction-category file)

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Look up a key not on file and open it as a new category
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for Type `09` / code `0001`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `09`, Cat Code `0001`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=09, Cat Code=0001 (not on file)
cases.expected: The key is reported as new; the Desc field is left blank ready for entry; the message line shows `New category. Enter text, PF5 to add.`; the cursor moves to the Desc field so the operator can type a description and add it with PF5.
cases.remark: 2100-LOOKUP → 3000-READ-TCAT RESP(NOTFND) REC-NOT-FOUND · MOVE SPACES TO TCDESCO · state 'N' (WS-ST-NEW) · WS-M-NEW

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Add a new transaction category
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for Type `06` / code `0001`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `06`, Cat Code `0001` and press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type Desc `CASH ADVANCE`.
3. Press PF5 to add.
cases.data: Type Code=06, Cat Code=0001, Desc=CASH ADVANCE
cases.expected: A new category record is added to the transaction-category file with description `CASH ADVANCE`; the message line shows `Transaction category added.`; the state becomes existing so a further PF5 would update the same record.
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE (state 'N') → 3600-ADD-TCAT WRITE RESP(NORMAL) · WS-M-ADDED · MOVE WS-ST-EXIST TO CA-WORK-AREA(1:1) · TCATFILE

cases.mid: 機能・業務フロー (Function / business flow)
cases.name: Change the description of an existing transaction category
cases.precondition: F-STD. Category Type `01` / code `0002` exists on file with description `RESTAURANT`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`, Cat Code `0002` and press ENTER (reported as found).
2. Change Desc to `DINING AND RESTAURANTS`.
3. Press PF5 to update.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=0002, new Desc=DINING AND RESTAURANTS
cases.expected: The category record is updated in place with the new description `DINING AND RESTAURANTS`; the message line shows `Transaction category updated.`; the key is unchanged.
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE (state 'E') → 3500-UPDATE-TCAT READ UPDATE + REWRITE RESP(NORMAL) · MOVE TCDESCI TO TC-DESC · WS-M-UPDATED

cases.mid: 計算・編集ロジック (Calculation / editing logic)
cases.name: Category code with leading spaces is parsed and normalised to a four-digit value
cases.precondition: F-STD. Category Type `01` / code `0003` exists on file (TRAVEL AND LODGING).
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`.
2. In Cat Code type a leading space then `3` (entered as ` 3`).
3. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=` 3` (space + digit)
cases.expected: The category code parser skips the space, keeps the single digit and normalises the value to `0003`; the key `01`/`0003` is found and description `TRAVEL AND LODGING` is shown; the message line shows `Category found. Change text, PF5 to update.`
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-NUM: WHEN SPACE CONTINUE, WHEN '0'..'9' accumulate; WS-NC-DIGITS=1 → WS-NC-VALUE=3 → WS-TC-CD=0003 · found path 2100-LOOKUP REC-FOUND

cases.mid: 出力・帳票 (Output / report)
cases.name: Added record carries the exact key, description and initialised filler
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for Type `02` / code `0002`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `02`, Cat Code `0002` and press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type Desc `MOBILE WALLET PAYMENT`.
3. Press PF5 to add.
4. Inspect the written record on file.
cases.data: Type Code=02, Cat Code=0002, Desc=MOBILE WALLET PAYMENT
cases.expected: The written record holds Type Cd `02`, Cat Cd `0002`, Desc `MOBILE WALLET PAYMENT` (left-justified, space-padded to 50) and the 4-byte trailing filler cleared to spaces; the message line shows `Transaction category added.`
cases.remark: 3600-ADD-TCAT: INITIALIZE TCAT-REC → MOVE key + TCDESCI TO TC-DESC → WRITE · RTCAT layout TC-TYPE-CD X(2) + TC-CD 9(4) + TC-DESC X(50) + FILLER X(4)

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: Pressing PF5 twice after an add updates the same record instead of duplicating it
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for Type `08` / code `0001` at the start.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `08`, Cat Code `0001`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type Desc `FOREIGN PURCHASE` and press PF5 (added).
3. Without changing the key, press PF5 again.
cases.data: Type Code=08, Cat Code=0001, Desc=FOREIGN PURCHASE
cases.expected: The first PF5 adds the record (`Transaction category added.`) and flips the state to existing; the second PF5 updates the same record rather than creating a duplicate, and the message line shows `Transaction category updated.`; only one record for `08`/`0001` exists on file.
cases.remark: 3600-ADD-TCAT sets state 'E' after WRITE NORMAL → subsequent 2300-SAVE takes the state 'E' branch → 3500-UPDATE-TCAT REWRITE · idempotent

cases.mid: データ整合性・冪等性 (Data integrity / idempotency)
cases.name: An update preserves the key and is visible on a fresh lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. Category Type `03` / code `0001` exists on file with description `ATM WITHDRAWAL`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `03`, Cat Code `0001`, press ENTER (found).
2. Change Desc to `ATM CASH WITHDRAWAL` and press PF5 (updated).
3. Press PF4 to clear, then re-enter Type Code `03`, Cat Code `0001` and press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=03, Cat Code=0001, new Desc=ATM CASH WITHDRAWAL
cases.expected: The re-lookup returns the same key `03`/`0001` with the updated description `ATM CASH WITHDRAWAL`; the message line shows `Category found. Change text, PF5 to update.`; the key was not altered by the update.
cases.remark: 3500-UPDATE-TCAT REWRITE (key from RIDFLD unchanged, only TC-DESC changed) → re-read 2100-LOOKUP REC-FOUND shows new TC-DESC

cases.mid: 連携・インターフェース (Linkage / interface)
cases.name: PF3 returns control to the main menu
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed (any state).
cases.steps: 1. On the maintenance screen press PF3.
cases.expected: Control is handed back to the main menu program (OCMENU); the commarea (with the originating program and transaction recorded) is passed along so the menu can display; the maintenance screen is left.
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT WHEN DFHPF3 → 7000-XCTL-MENU: MOVE WS-PGMNAME/WS-TRANID TO CA-FROM-*, CA-PGM-CONTEXT=0, EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM('OCMENU') COMMAREA(ORION-COMMAREA)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Type code left blank is rejected on lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. The screen is at key-entry.
cases.steps:
1. Leave Type Code blank; enter Cat Code `0001`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=(blank), Cat Code=0001
cases.expected: The lookup is rejected; the message line shows `Type code is required.` and the cursor returns to the Type Code field; no record is read.
cases.remark: 6100-VALIDATE-KEY: IF TCTYPEI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES → SET WS-INVALID, WS-M-TYPE-REQ, GO TO 6100-EXIT · MOVE -1 TO TCTYPEL

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Blank category code is rejected as non-numeric on lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. The screen is at key-entry.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`; leave Cat Code blank.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=(blank)
cases.expected: The lookup is rejected because the category code yields no digits; the message line shows `Category code must be numeric.` and no record is read.
cases.remark: 6100-VALIDATE-KEY → 6000-PARSE-NUM: WS-NC-DIGITS=0 → SET WS-INVALID → WS-M-CD-NUM (blank category, no digits)

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: Non-numeric category code is rejected on lookup
cases.precondition: F-STD. The screen is at key-entry.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`; in Cat Code type `12A3`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=12A3
cases.expected: The lookup is rejected because the category code contains a non-digit character; the message line shows `Category code must be numeric.` and no record is read.
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-NUM: WHEN OTHER (char 'A' not space, not '0'..'9') → SET WS-INVALID → 6100 WS-M-CD-NUM

cases.mid: 入力チェック (Input validation)
cases.name: A blank description is rejected when saving
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for Type `09` / code `0001`; the operator has looked it up (reported as new).
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `09`, Cat Code `0001`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Leave Desc blank.
3. Press PF5 to save.
cases.data: Type Code=09, Cat Code=0001, Desc=(blank)
cases.expected: The save is rejected; the message line shows `Description is required.`, the cursor returns to the Desc field and no record is written.
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE: IF TCDESCI = SPACES OR LOW-VALUES → WS-M-DESC-REQ, MOVE -1 TO TCDESCL (no WRITE/REWRITE)

cases.mid: 操作性・キー (Operability / function keys)
cases.name: An unsupported function key is rejected with a message
cases.precondition: F-STD. The maintenance screen is displayed.
cases.steps: 1. Press PF1 (an unsupported key).
cases.data: AID key = PF1
cases.expected: The action is rejected; the message line shows `Invalid key pressed. Please try again.` and the screen stays on the maintenance map awaiting a supported key (ENTER / PF3 / PF4 / PF5).
cases.remark: 2000-PROCESS-INPUT EVALUATE EIBAID WHEN OTHER → MOVE WS-MSG-INVALID-KEY TO ERRMSGO → 8100-SEND-DATAONLY

cases.mid: 排他・同時実行 (Exclusion / concurrent access)
cases.name: A save that collides with an already-existing key reports a save error
cases.precondition: F-STD. A key looked up as new is created by another task before this operator's PF5 (so the add hits a duplicate). *(needs concurrent/fault injection)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `09`, Cat Code `0002`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Another task adds `09`/`0002` in the meantime.
3. Type Desc `PENDING CATEGORY` and press PF5 to add.
cases.data: Type Code=09, Cat Code=0002, Desc=PENDING CATEGORY *(needs real data)*
cases.expected: The add fails because the key already exists (duplicate); the message line shows `Error saving the transaction category.` and no second record is created; the same message also covers a rewrite that returns a non-normal response.
cases.remark: 3600-ADD-TCAT WRITE RESP(DUPREC) → WS-M-SAVE-ERR; also 3500-UPDATE-TCAT REWRITE non-NORMAL → WS-M-SAVE-ERR · runtime/contention

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: Pressing PF5 to save before looking up a key is rejected
cases.precondition: F-STD. The screen is at key-entry (state 'K'); no ENTER lookup has been done yet.
cases.steps:
1. On the fresh screen type Type Code `01`, Cat Code `0001`, Desc `SOME TEXT`.
2. Press PF5 (without pressing ENTER first).
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001, Desc=SOME TEXT (no prior ENTER)
cases.expected: The save is rejected because the key has not been looked up; the message line shows `Enter the key and press ENTER first.` and the cursor returns to the Type Code field; nothing is written.
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE guard: IF CA-WORK-AREA(1:1) NOT = 'E' AND NOT = 'N' → WS-M-KEY-FIRST, MOVE -1 TO TCTYPEL (state still 'K')

cases.mid: メッセージ・異常系 (Messages / abnormal)
cases.name: An unrecoverable file error ends the transaction with a support message
cases.precondition: F-STD. The transaction-category file is unavailable or returns an I/O error on read. *(needs fault injection)*
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`, Cat Code `0001`.
2. Press ENTER while the file read returns an unrecoverable error.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=0001 (file I/O forced to error) *(needs real data)*
cases.expected: The program cannot continue and aborts the transaction, sending the full-screen text `OCTCAT: unrecoverable file error. Contact support.` and ending the task without resuming the maintenance screen.
cases.remark: 3000-READ-TCAT / 3500-UPDATE-TCAT EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD WHEN OTHER → 9500-ABEND-RTN: SEND TEXT WS-MSG-TEXT + RETURN · runtime/env fault

cases.mid: 回復・リラン (Recovery / rerun)
cases.name: Pressing ENTER with nothing transmitted is handled as empty input
cases.precondition: F-STD. The screen is fresh at key-entry; the operator types nothing.
cases.steps: 1. Without typing anything, press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=(nothing transmitted), Cat Code=(nothing)
cases.expected: The empty transmit is treated as blank input (the read maps it to low-values); the required-field check fires and the message line shows `Type code is required.`, leaving the operator on the key-entry screen to try again.
cases.remark: 2050-RECEIVE: IF WS-RESP-CD = DFHRESP(MAPFAIL) MOVE LOW-VALUES TO MTCATAI → 6100-VALIDATE-KEY sees TCTYPEI LOW-VALUES → WS-M-TYPE-REQ

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Category code at its maximum value 9999 is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for Type `01` / code `9999`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`, Cat Code `9999`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type Desc `HIGH RANGE CATEGORY` and press PF5 to add.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=9999, Desc=HIGH RANGE CATEGORY
cases.expected: The four-digit maximum `9999` is accepted as numeric and stored; the message line shows `Transaction category added.`
cases.remark: TCCD map length 4 → 6000-PARSE-NUM digits=4, value 9999 (max) · TC-CD PIC 9(04) · 3600-ADD-TCAT WRITE NORMAL

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: Category value zero is accepted as numeric
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for Type `07` / code `0000`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `07`, Cat Code `0000`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=07, Cat Code=0000 (not on file)
cases.expected: The all-zeros category is accepted as value `0000` (four digits count as numeric); the key is reported as new and the message line shows `New category. Enter text, PF5 to add.`
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-NUM: '0' is within '0'..'9' → digits=4, value 0 > 0 digits → valid · WS-TC-CD=0000 · 2100-LOOKUP REC-NOT-FOUND → WS-M-NEW

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A single-digit category code is normalised to four digits
cases.precondition: F-STD. Category Type `01` / code `0001` exists on file (RETAIL PURCHASE).
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `01`; in Cat Code type just `1`.
2. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=01, Cat Code=1
cases.expected: The single digit is accepted (one digit is the minimum numeric) and normalised to `0001`; the existing key `01`/`0001` is found with description `RETAIL PURCHASE`; the message line shows `Category found. Change text, PF5 to update.`
cases.remark: 6000-PARSE-NUM digits=1, value 1 → WS-TC-CD=0001 · equals seed key · 2100-LOOKUP REC-FOUND

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A single-character type code is accepted
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for a type of `9` / code `0001`.
cases.steps:
1. In Type Code type a single character `9` (one of the two positions).
2. Enter Cat Code `0001`.
3. Press ENTER.
cases.data: Type Code=9 (1 char), Cat Code=0001
cases.expected: The one-character type is accepted (it is not blank, so the required check passes); the key is looked up and reported as new; the message line shows `New category. Enter text, PF5 to add.`
cases.remark: 6100-VALIDATE-KEY: TCTYPEI not blank → valid · WS-TC-TYPE X(2) = '9 ' (INSPECT LOW-VALUE→SPACE) · min length 1

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A description at the maximum 50 characters is accepted and stored
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for Type `09` / code `0001`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `09`, Cat Code `0001`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type a 50-character Desc `AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA`.
3. Press PF5 to add.
cases.data: Type Code=09, Cat Code=0001, Desc=50 chars (`A`×50)
cases.expected: The full 50-character description fills the field and is stored without truncation; the message line shows `Transaction category added.`
cases.remark: TCDESC map length 50 = TC-DESC PIC X(50) · 3600-ADD-TCAT MOVE TCDESCI TO TC-DESC (max length)

cases.mid: 境界値 (Boundary values)
cases.name: A single-character description is accepted and stored
cases.precondition: F-STD. No category exists for Type `09` / code `0002`.
cases.steps:
1. Enter Type Code `09`, Cat Code `0002`, press ENTER (reported as new).
2. Type a one-character Desc `X`.
3. Press PF5 to add.
cases.data: Type Code=09, Cat Code=0002, Desc=X
cases.expected: The one-character description is accepted (it is not blank, so the required check passes) and stored as `X` padded with spaces; the message line shows `Transaction category added.`
cases.remark: 2300-SAVE: TCDESCI not blank → passes desc-required · 3600-ADD-TCAT WRITE NORMAL · min non-blank length 1
